# Upstash

> > Upstash is a serverless data platform providing Redis, Vector databases, QStash message queue, and Workflow orchestration optimized for edge computing and serverless architectures.

Upstash specializes in serverless infrastructure with products including Redis for caching and data storage, Vector for AI embeddings, QStash for messaging, and Workflow for orchestration. The platform integrates seamlessly with edge runtimes like Cloudflare Workers and Vercel, supporting frameworks such as Next.js and technologies like TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.

## Key Topics

- Serverless architecture
- Redis caching and data storage
- Edge computing with Cloudflare Workers
- QStash message queue
- Rate limiting
- Next.js integration
- Upstash Vector database
- Workflow orchestration
- REST API optimization
- TypeScript and Node.js SDKs
- AI and LangChain integration
- Global database replication
- Vercel deployment
- Strapi CMS caching

## Redis Caching and Performance

- [5 ms Global Redis Latency with Edge Caching](https://upstash.com/blog/edge-caching-benchmark): Performance benchmark: 5ms global Redis latency using edge caching

- [Speed up your Database with Global Redis](https://upstash.com/blog/redis-in-sql-apps): Using Global Redis for distributed caching with PostgreSQL and MySQL
- [Speed up Strapi Apps with Caching](https://upstash.com/blog/strapi-rest-caching): Strapi REST API performance optimization with Upstash Redis caching
- [Serverless Redis Caching for Strapi](https://upstash.com/blog/redis-strapi): Tutorial on integrating Redis caching with Strapi CMS using REST Cache
